posts.text: Every $100 paid in $THREE on three.ws/three-token is now split by a published policy, and the page shows the exact numbers. Paid compute: $70 to the treasury, $30 to holder rewards. A marketplace sale: the seller keeps $90, with $5 to the treasury and $5 to holder rewards. A copy-trading performance fee: the trader you copy keeps $80. The splits are read live from the public token config, the same one the payment code enforces, and nothing is burned: every share goes to a seller, the treasury, or holders.

Two more rows on the page. A scarcity mint, which covers limited drops, rare-name auctions and pay-to-mint, splits $80 to the treasury and $20 to holder rewards. A paid spin of the in-app wheel splits $50 and $50. The treasury and holder-rewards addresses are not published yet, and the page says so: payments that include those shares are paused until they are, so no money is ever sent to an unset address.
